title: [19/3/2022] Investment in funds of four categories from 1988 to 2014
prompt: The graph shows the value in US dollars (in millions of dollars) of investment in funds of four categories from 1988 to 2014. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph displays trends in the values of four different investment categories in the United States between 1988 and 2014.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, all types of investments showed an upward trend over the period, with gold experiencing the most dramatic increase, particularly after 2006. Both fine art and gold values demonstrated significant volatility, while company shares and property showed more steady growth patterns.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at precious metals and art, gold investment started at around 100 million dollars in 1988 and remained relatively stable until 2006, after which it rose sharply to peak at 450 million in 2012, before declining to 380 million by 2014. Fine art values followed a somewhat similar pattern, starting at 75 million, remaining stable until 2002, then increasing substantially to reach 330 million dollars by 2014.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding property and company shares, these categories showed more gradual changes. Company shares rose steadily from 35 million dollars in 1988 to stabilize around 250 million by 2014. Property values demonstrated the most modest growth, increasing gradually from 50 million dollars in 1988 to approximately 190 million dollars by the end of the period.
